turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Starting spindle diagnostic procedure.

ground_truth.node_text: Start

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Begin with a warm-up run. Set the spindle to fifty percent speed and let it run for ten minutes.

ground_truth.node_text: Warm up run, spindle at 50% speed for 10 minutes

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Warm-up complete. Spindle has been running at fifty percent for ten minutes.

ground_truth.node_text: Warm up run, spindle at 50% speed for 10 minutes

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Mount a calibrated accelerometer on the front bearing housing using a flat washer stud or magnetic base. Run the spindle at three thousand RPM with no toolholder fitted and record the RMS vibration velocity in millimeters per second. Then repeat the measurement at maximum rated speed and compare both readings against the ISO ten eight one six zone limits for this machine class.

ground_truth.node_text: Mount a calibrated accelerometer on the front bearing housing with a flat washer stud or magnetic base. Run the spindle at 3000 revolutions per minute with no toolholder fitted and record the root mean square vibration velocity in millimetres per second. Repeat at the maximum rated speed and compare both readings against the ISO 10816 zone limits for this machine class.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Accelerometer mounted and measurements taken at both speeds. I've recorded the vibration velocity values and compared them to the ISO limits.

ground_truth.node_text: Mount a calibrated accelerometer on the front bearing housing with a flat washer stud or magnetic base. Run the spindle at 3000 revolutions per minute with no toolholder fitted and record the root mean square vibration velocity in millimetres per second. Repeat at the maximum rated speed and compare both readings against the ISO 10816 zone limits for this machine class.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the vibration level below the alarm limit?

ground_truth.node_text: Vibration level below alarm limit?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, both readings are well within acceptable limits, below the alarm threshold.

ground_truth.node_text: Vibration level below alarm limit?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the bearing temperature within the rated operating limit?

ground_truth.node_text: Bearing temperature within rated operating limit?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, bearing temperatures are within normal range. The temperature rise is under twenty-five degrees Celsius above ambient.

ground_truth.node_text: Bearing temperature within rated operating limit?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the radial runout within two micrometer tolerance?

ground_truth.node_text: Radial runout within 2 µm tolerance?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, the total indicator reading shows runout exceeding two micrometers. It's out of spec.

ground_truth.node_text: Radial runout within 2 µm tolerance?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Adjust the bearing preload via the locknut in quarter-turn increments.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust bearing pre load via locknut, quarter turn increments

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Preload adjustment completed. I've turned the locknut a quarter turn.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust bearing pre load via locknut, quarter turn increments

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Reverify the radial runout after the preload adjustment.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify radial runout after pre load adjustment

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The runout is still out of specification after the locknut adjustment. It hasn't improved enough.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify radial runout after pre load adjustment

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Perform supplementary bearing preload correction. Disassemble the spindle nose bearing housing, remove the preload spacer, and replace it with a spacer from the next shim increment in the bearing service kit. Reassemble the housing to the specified torque and run the spindle at one thousand RPM for ten minutes to allow the bearings to seat before returning to the runout measurement.

ground_truth.node_text: Supplementary bearing preload correction: disassemble the spindle nose bearing housing, remove the preload spacer, and replace it with a spacer from the next shim increment in the bearing service kit. Reassemble the housing to the specified torque and run the spindle at 1000 revolutions per minute for 10 minutes to allow bearings to seat before returning to the runout measurement step.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Housing disassembled, spacer replaced with the next increment shim, and reassembled to spec. I've run the spindle at one thousand RPM for ten minutes to seat the bearings.

ground_truth.node_text: Supplementary bearing preload correction: disassemble the spindle nose bearing housing, remove the preload spacer, and replace it with a spacer from the next shim increment in the bearing service kit. Reassemble the housing to the specified torque and run the spindle at 1000 revolutions per minute for 10 minutes to allow bearings to seat before returning to the runout measurement step.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Reverify the radial runout after the preload adjustment.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify radial runout after pre load adjustment

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Good news. The runout is now within tolerance after the spacer replacement.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify radial runout after pre load adjustment

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the axial play within three micrometer tolerance?

ground_truth.node_text: Axial play within 3 µm tolerance?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, the averaged axial deflection exceeds three micrometers. The play is too high.

ground_truth.node_text: Axial play within 3 µm tolerance?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Adjust the preload spacer or shim to reduce the axial play.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust pre load spacer or shim to reduce axial play

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Spacer adjusted to reduce axial play. The shim has been replaced.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust pre load spacer or shim to reduce axial play

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Apply a thin, even coat of engineer's blue to a clean test arbor with the correct taper angle. Insert the arbor, rotate by hand under moderate axial load, then withdraw and inspect the contact pattern. The blue should transfer uniformly over at least seventy percent of the taper length.

ground_truth.node_text: Apply a thin even coat of engineer's blue to a clean test arbor with the correct taper angle for this spindle. Insert the arbor, rotate by hand under moderate axial load, then withdraw and inspect the contact pattern. The blue should transfer uniformly over at least 70% of the taper length; a spotted or narrow band pattern indicates taper bore damage or swarf contamination.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Test arbor inserted and rotated under load. I've withdrawn it and inspected the blue transfer pattern.

ground_truth.node_text: Apply a thin even coat of engineer's blue to a clean test arbor with the correct taper angle for this spindle. Insert the arbor, rotate by hand under moderate axial load, then withdraw and inspect the contact pattern. The blue should transfer uniformly over at least 70% of the taper length; a spotted or narrow band pattern indicates taper bore damage or swarf contamination.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the taper contact pattern above eighty-five percent bearing area?

ground_truth.node_text: Taper contact pattern above 85% bearing area?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the blue has transferred uniformly. The contact pattern shows well over eighty-five percent coverage.

ground_truth.node_text: Taper contact pattern above 85% bearing area?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the drawbar retention force within the rated range?

ground_truth.node_text: Drawbar retention force within rated range?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, the peak extraction force is below the minimum specification. The drawbar force is too low.

ground_truth.node_text: Drawbar retention force within rated range?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Adjust the drawbar spring stack or replace the disc springs.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust drawbar spring stack or replace disc springs

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Disc springs replaced and spring stack adjusted. The drawbar assembly is reassembled.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust drawbar spring stack or replace disc springs

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Mount a dial test indicator against the reference artefact clamped in the spindle at cold start. Zero the indicator and allow the spindle to run at operating speed for thirty minutes. Record the indicator displacement at ten-minute intervals and note the total thermal growth value at stabilization, then compare against the growth compensation value stored in the machine thermal compensation table.

ground_truth.node_text: Mount a dial test indicator against the reference artefact clamped in the spindle at cold start. Zero the indicator and allow the spindle to run at operating speed for 30 minutes. Record the indicator displacement at 10 minute intervals and note the total thermal growth value at stabilisation; compare against the growth compensation value stored in the machine thermal compensation table.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Indicator zeroed at cold start and I've monitored thermal growth over thirty minutes. The stabilized growth value has been recorded and compared to the compensation table.

ground_truth.node_text: Mount a dial test indicator against the reference artefact clamped in the spindle at cold start. Zero the indicator and allow the spindle to run at operating speed for 30 minutes. Record the indicator displacement at 10 minute intervals and note the total thermal growth value at stabilisation; compare against the growth compensation value stored in the machine thermal compensation table.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the thermal growth within the compensation model tolerance?

ground_truth.node_text: Thermal growth within compensation model tolerance?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, the measured thermal growth deviates from the stored compensation model. It's outside tolerance.

ground_truth.node_text: Thermal growth within compensation model tolerance?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Complete the following checks: Read the thermal compensation growth coefficient from the controller, compare the stored values against the reference values for this spindle, and check whether the compensation parameters were modified since the last service.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Read the thermal compensation growth coefficient from the controller. 2. Compare the stored values against the reference values for this spindle. 3. Check whether the compensation parameters were modified since last service.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Controller parameters reviewed. I've compared the coefficients to reference values and checked the modification history.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Read the thermal compensation growth coefficient from the controller. 2. Compare the stored values against the reference values for this spindle. 3. Check whether the compensation parameters were modified since last service.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Reverify the thermal compensation after the parameter update.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify thermal compensation after parameter update

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The thermal model is still diverging even after checking the parameters. The growth pattern doesn't match.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify thermal compensation after parameter update

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Procedure complete. Escalate immediately: thermal model divergence detected, metrology review required. Do not release this spindle to production until the thermal compensation has been validated by the metrology team.

ground_truth.node_text: End, Escalate: thermal model divergence, metrology review

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Understood. I'll escalate to metrology for thermal model review.

ground_truth.node_text: End, Escalate: thermal model divergence, metrology review
